method.timing: scan_ms includes native observations and scan; excludes runtime setup, serialization, index, queries; process_wall_ms includes startup and output
method.peak_rss: OS process high-water mark read when scan returns, before diagnostic hashing/queries/serialization; bytes or null
method.metadata_calls: Platform metadata plus scan_metadata invocations, not total native syscalls
method.paths: omitted; runner output restricted to known scalar fields

source_provenance.reference_source: git archive of the exact reference commit into an owned temporary checkout; no worktree or Git mutations
source_provenance.benchmark_fixture_cleanup: The harness-owned temporary directory was cleaned before it wrote this report; separate UI fixture/state/binaries were preserved
source_provenance.scope: warm-cache owned synthetic core scans only; no drop-caches, no user-directory scans, no simultaneous managed builds/scans; OS and other desktop activity were uncontrolled
